turns.question: What was the ratio of non-cancelled order revenue to total ad spend in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no ratio metric, so here are the two figures it does have for 1 to 30 September 2026: non-cancelled order revenue (Revenue (EUR), revenue_eur) was EUR 12,582.75 and total ad spend (Ad spend (EUR), ad_spend_eur) was EUR 6,270.00.
